description:
My name is Anna Weber. I had to cancel my trip to Lisbon because I was admitted to hospital with acute appendicitis on 20 March 2025, two days before departure.
I attach the hospital certificate and my booking confirmation. I am asking for a refund of the 1,240 euros I paid.

decision.explanation: Your trip cancellation claim is otherwise supported by the hospital certificate and the booking confirmation, which show the 20 March 2025 hospital admission and the 22 March 2025 departure. We are referring the claim for review because the policy period and policy end date are not established in the documents we have, so we cannot confirm that the incident occurred within the policy period or that the claim was submitted within 30 days of the policy ending. The documents also do not state whether you knew of the hospital admission or its reason before purchasing the policy, even though a purchase date is established. The claim description does not state that personal belongings were lost, stolen, or damaged, and no police report or airline acknowledgement is provided for that coverage. Please provide the missing policy period details and any evidence bearing on prior knowledge so the open exclusions can be decided.
